## 1. Executive Summary

A comprehensive, opaque-box, requirement-driven end-to-end (E2E) readiness test suite has been designed, implemented, and verified for the OneWayCabs (`onewaytaxibihar.com`) platform. 

The test harness provides strict, non-facade verification across all **19 production-readiness criteria** structured into a **4-Tier Testing Hierarchy**, culminating in the **P0 Full Lifecycle Integration Smoke Test**.

### Key Highlights
- **126 Comprehensive Test Cases**:
  - **Tier 1 (Feature Coverage)**: 95 tests (5 rigorous tests for each of the 19 criteria).
  - **Tier 2 (Boundary & Corner Cases)**: 17 adversarial and stress tests.
  - **Tier 3 (Cross-Feature Integrations)**: 10 multi-module state machine interaction tests.
  - **Tier 4 (Real-World Scenarios & Smoke Tests)**: 4 full end-to-end workflow tests, including the orchestrator's P0 lifecycle test.
- **Strict Anti-Facade Policy**: All tests exercise live backend handler logic (`api/index.js`), in-memory database queries (`services/db.js`), and frontend utility modules (`mobile/shared/utils/formatters.ts`). No mocks or fake bypasses are used.
- **Sandboxed Execution Integrity**: Employs an in-process Node.js request/response dispatcher (`Readable.from` stream + synthetic response) to execute 100% of the live Express/Vercel router stack with zero network latency and complete immunity to Windows OS loopback port sandbox restrictions.
- **P0 Full Lifecycle Smoke Test (T4.4)**: **PASSED (100% Green)**.
  `Passenger Booking ➔ Server Fare Calculation ➔ Admin Dispatch / Auto-Dispatch ➔ Driver Offer Accept ➔ Start Ride OTP Verification ➔ Live Route GPS Tracking ➔ Trip Complete ➔ Payment Settlement ➔ Driver Wallet Ledger Entry`.
- **Phase 1 (TypeScript Strict Compilation)**: **PASSED (0 Errors)** across 4 configs (`mobile`, `passenger`, `driver`, `admin`).
- **Phase 2 (Database Backup & Restore Automation)**: **PASSED (100% Green)**.

## 3. How to Run the Verification Suite

### Option A: Complete 3-Phase Verification (Recommended)
Executes Phase 1 (TypeScript compilation), Phase 2 (DB Backup/Restore), and Phase 3 (E2E Readiness Suite):
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/verify-all-19-readiness.ps1
```

### Option B: Run Specific Tiers with the PowerShell Runner
Filter by tier using the `-TierFilter` parameter:
```powershell
# Run only Tier 4 Real-World Scenarios & P0 Lifecycle Smoke Test
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/verify-all-19-readiness.ps1 -TierFilter "Tier 4"

# Run only Tier 3 Cross-Feature Integrations
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/verify-all-19-readiness.ps1 -TierFilter "Tier 3"

# Run only Tier 2 Boundary & Edge Cases
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/verify-all-19-readiness.ps1 -TierFilter "Tier 2"

# Run only Tier 1 Feature Coverage
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/verify-all-19-readiness.ps1 -TierFilter "Tier 1"
```

### Option C: Direct Node Native Test Runner
Execute tests directly using Node 20+ test runner:
```powershell
# Run entire suite
node --test tests/e2e-readiness.test.js

# Run specific criterion (e.g. Criterion 1)
node --test --test-name-pattern="Criterion 1" tests/e2e-readiness.test.js

# Run P0 Lifecycle Smoke Test specifically
node --test --test-name-pattern="T4.4" tests/e2e-readiness.test.js
```

## 5. Implementation Defect Catalog & Milestone Action Plan

The 59 failing tests provide the exact specification and contract tests that downstream worker agents must satisfy. In accordance with the Test Writer QA protocol, no application code was silently patched; defects are formally escalated below:

### Milestone 1: Backend Security & Core Lifecycle APIs (`worker_m1`)
| Test ID / Area | Requirement & Observation | Expected Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Criterion 1 (1.1, 1.2)** | `POST /api/auth/login` for passengers currently issues legacy tokens. | Issue tokens prefixed with `otb_sess_` and support session renewal / `/api/auth/me`. |
| **Criterion 2 (2.3, 2.4)** | `POST /api/driver/logout` endpoint is missing in `api/index.js` (returns 404). | Implement `POST /api/driver/logout` and revoke active JWT tokens in driver session store. |
| **Criterion 3 (3.2, 3.3, 3.4)** | `POST /api/auth/forgot-password` does not reject non-10-digit phones with 400. `POST /api/auth/reset-password` does not purge existing active sessions. | Enforce strict phone validation and invalidate all prior sessions upon credential change. |
| **Criterion 4 (4.1, 4.2, 4.3)** | `POST /api/auth/send-verification-email` and `GET /api/auth/verify-email` are not hooked up in the main router. | Mount email verification endpoints and update user `emailVerified: true` status. |
| **Criterion 13 (13.1, 13.2, 13.3)** | Dynamic `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` routes do not serve disallow rules or sitemap tags via the API router. | Serve canonical `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` with appropriate Content-Type headers. |
| **Criterion 14 (14.1, 14.2)** | Real-time GPS ping (`POST /api/driver/location`) does not emit WebSocket telemetry to connected passenger clients. | Integrate WebSocket or SSE broadcaster on driver location updates. |

### Milestone 2: Mobile Auth, Safe Areas & Form Validation (`worker_m2`)
| Test ID / Area | Requirement & Observation | Expected Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Criterion 5 (5.1, 5.2, 5.3)** | `formatters.ts` missing exports: `isValidOtp`, `isValidUtr`, `isValidEmail`, `isValidIndianVehicleNumber`. | Implement and export validation functions matching Indian telecom and banking specs. |
| **Criterion 6 (6.1, 6.2, 6.3)** | Mobile screens in `mobile/apps/admin` hardcode `paddingTop: 54` instead of using `SafeAreaView` or `useSafeAreaInsets()`. | Replace fixed top paddings with `react-native-safe-area-context` safe area wrappers. |
| **Criterion 7 (7.1, 7.2, 7.3)** | `NotFoundScreen.tsx` is missing in `mobile/apps/passenger/screens` and driver navigators. | Add fallback `NotFoundScreen` with clear return-to-home navigation button. |

### Milestone 3: UX States, Telemetry & Polish (`worker_m3`)
| Test ID / Area | Requirement & Observation | Expected Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Criterion 8 (8.1, 8.2)** | `MyTripsScreen.tsx` and `DriverEarningsScreen.tsx` lack animated loading skeletons during data fetching. | Introduce `<SkeletonLoader>` placeholders while queries are in-flight. |
| **Criterion 9 (9.1, 9.2)** | Empty state components are missing friendly illustrations and "Book Now" / "Go Online" action buttons. | Add structured `<EmptyState>` components with distinct action triggers. |
| **Criterion 11 (11.1, 11.2, 11.3)** | Client error reporting endpoint (`POST /api/telemetry/errors`) does not persist crash breadcrumbs or stack traces. | Ingest client error payloads into DB audit logs queryable via `GET /api/admin/audit-logs`. |
| **Criterion 17 (17.1, 17.2)** | Web vitals and performance metrics ingestion endpoint (`POST /api/telemetry/vitals`) is not implemented. | Record FCP, LCP, CLS, and API response latencies into performance collections. |
